panels.title: Active players
panels.description: distinct human relay identities playing during the selected period

targets.queryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.username) AS players FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.username) AS players FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000

panels.title: Games started
panels.description: games started during the selected period

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS games FROM games WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS games FROM games WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000

panels.title: Completion rate
panels.description: ended games that reached a game-over result

targets.queryText: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(game_over) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS completion FROM games WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(game_over) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS completion FROM games WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000

targets.queryText: SELECT value AS accounts FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'accounts' ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT value AS accounts FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'accounts' ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Collection adoption
panels.description: share of accounts with a non-empty synced collection; current state

targets.queryText: SELECT round(100.0 * max(CASE WHEN metric = 'collection_collectors' THEN value END) / nullif(max(CASE WHEN metric = 'accounts' THEN value END), 0), 1) AS adoption FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE snapshot_at = (SELECT max(snapshot_at) FROM hub_metric_snapshots)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT round(100.0 * max(CASE WHEN metric = 'collection_collectors' THEN value END) / nullif(max(CASE WHEN metric = 'accounts' THEN value END), 0), 1) AS adoption FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE snapshot_at = (SELECT max(snapshot_at) FROM hub_metric_snapshots)

targets.queryText: SELECT value AS decks FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'decks_by_kind' AND dimension = 'user' ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT value AS decks FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'decks_by_kind' AND dimension = 'user' ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Games and active players by day

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(g.started_at)) AS INTEGER) AS t, count(DISTINCT g.game_id) AS games, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_bot = 0 THEN p.username END) AS players FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY date(g.started_at) ORDER BY date(g.started_at)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(g.started_at)) AS INTEGER) AS t, count(DISTINCT g.game_id) AS games, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_bot = 0 THEN p.username END) AS players FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY date(g.started_at) ORDER BY date(g.started_at)

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'accounts_created' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS accounts, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'decks_created' AND dimension = 'user' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS user_decks FROM hub_daily_metrics WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'accounts_created' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS accounts, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'decks_created' AND dimension = 'user' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS user_decks FROM hub_daily_metrics WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: New versus returning players
panels.description: a player is new on the first day their relay identity appears

targets.queryText: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT p.username, min(date(g.started_at)) AS first_day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 GROUP BY p.username), activity AS (SELECT date(g.started_at) AS day, p.username FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', a.day) AS INTEGER) AS t, count(CASE WHEN f.first_day = a.day THEN 1 END) AS new_players, count(CASE WHEN f.first_day < a.day THEN 1 END) AS returning_players FROM activity a JOIN first_seen f USING(username) GROUP BY a.day ORDER BY a.day
targets.rawQueryText: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT p.username, min(date(g.started_at)) AS first_day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 GROUP BY p.username), activity AS (SELECT date(g.started_at) AS day, p.username FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', a.day) AS INTEGER) AS t, count(CASE WHEN f.first_day = a.day THEN 1 END) AS new_players, count(CASE WHEN f.first_day < a.day THEN 1 END) AS returning_players FROM activity a JOIN first_seen f USING(username) GROUP BY a.day ORDER BY a.day

panels.title: Completion and problem endings
panels.description: completion rate and non-game-over endings by start day

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(started_at)) AS INTEGER) AS t, round(100.0 * sum(game_over) / nullif(count(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 1) AS completion_pct, sum(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND game_over = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS problem_endings FROM games WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY date(started_at) ORDER BY date(started_at)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(started_at)) AS INTEGER) AS t, round(100.0 * sum(game_over) / nullif(count(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 1) AS completion_pct, sum(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND game_over = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS problem_endings FROM games WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY date(started_at) ORDER BY date(started_at)

panels.title: Format demand
panels.description: games by format during the selected period

targets.queryText: SELECT coalesce(format, 'unknown') AS format, count(*) AS games FROM games WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT coalesce(format, 'unknown') AS format, count(*) AS games FROM games WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: How people play
panels.description: solo AI versus multiplayer during the selected period

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN humans = 0 THEN 'bots only' WHEN humans = 1 THEN 'solo vs AI' WHEN humans = 2 THEN '2 humans' ELSE '3+ humans' END AS mode, count(*) AS games FROM (SELECT g.game_id, count(CASE WHEN p.is_bot = 0 THEN 1 END) AS humans FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY g.game_id) GROUP BY mode ORDER BY games DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN humans = 0 THEN 'bots only' WHEN humans = 1 THEN 'solo vs AI' WHEN humans = 2 THEN '2 humans' ELSE '3+ humans' END AS mode, count(*) AS games FROM (SELECT g.game_id, count(CASE WHEN p.is_bot = 0 THEN 1 END) AS humans FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY g.game_id) GROUP BY mode ORDER BY games DESC

panels.title: Game endings requiring attention
panels.description: non-game-over endings during the selected period

targets.queryText: SELECT end_reason AS reason, count(*) AS games, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM games WHERE game_over = 0 AND ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY end_reason ORDER BY games DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT end_reason AS reason, count(*) AS games, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM games WHERE game_over = 0 AND ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY end_reason ORDER BY games DESC

panels.description: seconds since the latest stored relay event

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%s', 'now') - max(strftime('%s', ts)) AS seconds FROM events
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', 'now') - max(strftime('%s', ts)) AS seconds FROM events

panels.description: seconds since the latest successful sanitized Hub export

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%s', 'now') - coalesce((SELECT strftime('%s', synced_at) FROM hub_sync_state WHERE id = 1), 0) AS seconds
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', 'now') - coalesce((SELECT strftime('%s', synced_at) FROM hub_sync_state WHERE id = 1), 0) AS seconds

panels.title: Analytics drops
panels.description: relay analytics and Deck Hub evidence drops since process start

panels.title: How does this compare with the previous period?
Player change
panels.description: active-player change versus the immediately preceding period of equal length

targets.queryText: WITH periods AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 THEN p.username END) AS current, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > (2 * $__from - $__to) / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__from / 1000 THEN p.username END) AS previous FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0) SELECT round(100.0 * (current - previous) / nullif(previous, 0), 1) AS change FROM periods
targets.rawQueryText: WITH periods AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 THEN p.username END) AS current, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > (2 * $__from - $__to) / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__from / 1000 THEN p.username END) AS previous FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0) SELECT round(100.0 * (current - previous) / nullif(previous, 0), 1) AS change FROM periods

panels.title: Game change
panels.description: game-start change versus the immediately preceding period of equal length

targets.queryText: WITH periods AS (SELECT count(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 THEN 1 END) AS current, count(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > (2 * $__from - $__to) / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__from / 1000 THEN 1 END) AS previous FROM games) SELECT round(100.0 * (current - previous) / nullif(previous, 0), 1) AS change FROM periods
targets.rawQueryText: WITH periods AS (SELECT count(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 THEN 1 END) AS current, count(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > (2 * $__from - $__to) / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__from / 1000 THEN 1 END) AS previous FROM games) SELECT round(100.0 * (current - previous) / nullif(previous, 0), 1) AS change FROM periods

panels.title: Completion change
panels.description: percentage-point completion change versus the preceding equal-length period

targets.queryText: WITH periods AS (SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 THEN game_over ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 THEN 1 END), 0) AS current, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > (2 * $__from - $__to) / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__from / 1000 THEN game_over ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > (2 * $__from - $__to) / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__from / 1000 THEN 1 END), 0) AS previous FROM games) SELECT round(current - previous, 1) AS percentage_points FROM periods
targets.rawQueryText: WITH periods AS (SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 THEN game_over ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 THEN 1 END), 0) AS current, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > (2 * $__from - $__to) / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__from / 1000 THEN game_over ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) > (2 * $__from - $__to) / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__from / 1000 THEN 1 END), 0) AS previous FROM games) SELECT round(current - previous, 1) AS percentage_points FROM periods
